patterns.PATTERN_NAME: After-Hours Rear Service Access Property Entry
patterns.PATTERN_SUMMARY: Targeted entry into commercial or mixed-use properties outside trading hours via rear, side, or service access points (loading docks, staff doors, alleyways, fire exits). These points are often less visible and less monitored.
patterns.WHY_WATCH: Catalog indicators: Loitering or repeated approaches to rear/service doors after closing; Doors propped open, forced, or showing signs of tampering outside approved delivery windows; Vehicles parked in alleys or rear car parks with no legitimate reason; Movement from service areas into non-service zones; Activity on public holidays or very late/early hours Analyst review is required before any comparison or action.
patterns.SEARCH_QUERY: after-hours rear service access property entry loitering or repeated approaches to rear service doors after closing doors propped open forced or showing signs of tampering outside approved delivery windows
